Outcome_variable.evidence_source: Abstract Personality is considered a major determinant of adults and adolescents Subjective Well-Being (SWB); mainly due to its relation to emotional reactivity, emotional intensity, and to the duration of emotional reactions. ... The present study examines the relation between temperament and character to SWB at two points in time over a year in an adolescent sample (N = 109). ... Keywords Adolescents · Character · Cloninger's psychobiological model of personality · Happiness · Subjective well-being · Temperament and character inventory · Temperament
Outcome_variable.warning: Specific instrument for SWB/Happiness not mentioned, inferring 'life satisfaction' from 'Subjective Well-Being' and 'Happiness' keywords.
